entities.summary: Francine Prose is an American novelist, short story writer, essayist, and critic. She is writer-in-residence at Bard College and is a former president of PEN American Center. Francine Prose was a authors & novelists from Brooklyn (b. 1947-04-01, Brooklyn). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
